text: おじさんが　きんを　ほってたこと　おぼえて　いて　くれたんだね　おじさん　すごく　うれしいよ！

structure.jp: おじさんが　きんを　ほってたこと
structure.en: that this old guy was digging for gold

structure.jp: おぼえて　いて　くれたんだね
structure.en: you remembered it for me, didn't you

structure.jp: おじさん　すごく　うれしいよ！
structure.en: this old guy is really happy!

patterns.name: 〜こと (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: こと after a verb phrase turns it into 'the fact that...', so it can be the thing remembered. ほってた is short for ほっていた. きんを　ほってたこと = 'the fact that I was digging for gold'.

patterns.name: 〜てくれる
patterns.span: おぼえて　いて　くれた
patterns.explanation: くれる after a て-form says someone does the thing as a kindness to the speaker. おぼえて　いて　くれた = 'you kindly kept it in mind'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: のだ, here shortened to んだ, says the speaker has just realised how things are. くれたんだね = 'so you did (remember) for me, didn't you'.
